target = os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1])
executed = set()
def tracer(frame, event, arg):
    if event == 'line' and frame.f_code.co_filename == target:
        executed.add(frame.f_lineno)
    return tracer
sys.settrace(tracer)
sys.argv = sys.argv[2:]
import pytest
pytest.main(sys.argv)
sys.settrace(None)
src = open(target).read().splitlines()
import ast
tree = ast.parse("\n".join(src))
stmt_lines = set()
for node in ast.walk(tree):
    if isinstance(node, ast.stmt) and not isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
        stmt_lines.add(node.lineno)

for l in missing:
    print(l, src[l-1])
EOF

cd /dateutil && cat > /tmp/run_docs.py <<'EOF'
import re, doctest, sys
text = open('docs/examples.rst').read()
# split into sections by directive name
setup = {}
for m in re.finditer(r'\.\. testsetup:: (\w+)\n\n((?:    .*\n|\n)+)', text):
    setup[m.group(1)] = '\n'.join(l[4:] for l in m.group(2).splitlines())
total_fail = 0
for m in re.finditer(r'\.\. doctest:: (\w+)\n(   :options: .*\n)?\n((?:    .*\n|\n)+)', text):
    name = m.group(1)
    body = '\n'.join(l[4:] for l in m.group(3).splitlines())
    pre = setup.get(name, '')
    src = pre + '\n' + body
    parser = doctest.DocTestParser()
    test = parser.get_doctest(src, {}, name, 'examples.rst', 0)
    runner = doctest.DocTestRunner(optionflags=doctest.ELLIPSIS|doctest.NORMALIZE_WHITESPACE)
    runner.run(test)
    r = runner.summarize(verbose=False)
    if r.failed:
        print("FAILED section", name, r.failed)
        total_fail += r.failed
print("total failures", total_fail)
EOF
